title: acer oliverianum var. serrulatum
intro: Acer oliverianum var. serrulatum, commonly known as Japanese maple, is a deciduous shrub or small tree belonging to the Sapindaceae family. The plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, such as fever, rheumatism, and digestive problems. Health benefits include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help reduce oxidative stress and alleviate symptoms of various diseases. The bioactive constituents of Acer oliverianum var. serrulatum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and tannins, which are believed to contribute to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects.
